claims.head: The Red Wings will hunt a mismatch
claims.call: The Red Wings’ L3 (Rasmussen, Compher and Copp) spends at least 31% of its 5-on-5 time against the Blackhawks’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Red Wings keep sending Copp’s line (Rasmussen, Compher and Copp) out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Todd McLellan has been chasing an easier matchup for the team’s scorers. Tonight the Blackhawks’ fourth line is Smith, Greene and Greenway.
claims.nums: At home: 31% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 21% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Todd McLellan likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Blackhawks’ fourth line.

claims.head: One power play bites, one doesn’t
claims.body: On the power play, Detroit is one of the league’s best, but Chicago is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Every penalty the Blackhawks take could cost them.

notes.text: Bowen Byram is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 5 games. He is a top-pair defenseman. Wyatt Kaiser has taken his spot beside Artyom Levshunov.
Alex Vlasic is day to day (illness), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-four defenseman.
Dylan Larkin is out (not injury related injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Simon Edvinsson has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Ben Chiarot has taken his spot beside Moritz Seider.
Michal Postava was added to the roster on Oct 23.

DET.head: The matchup suits the Red Wings
DET.body: Detroit has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Blackhawks’ way back in is keeping dangerous shots away.

items.text: Patrick Kane faces Detroit for the first time since leaving.
